narration.prompt: [whispers] Alas-tres ng madaling-araw. Bumukas ang elevator sa lobby. Walang laman. [long pause] [softly] Security guard ako sa isang lumang building. Sa gabi, ako lang ang gising. [long pause] Sa monitor, galing ang elevator sa ikalabing-apat na palapag. Bakante 'yon. Matagal nang sarado. [long pause] Unang gabi, sinilip ko sa CCTV. Bumukas ang pinto sa ikalabing-apat. Walang tao. [long pause] Pangalawang gabi, may nakatayo sa dulo ng pasilyo. [long pause] Pangatlong gabi, nasa tapat na siya ng elevator. [long pause] [whispers] Kagabi, wala na siya sa ikalabing-apat. [long pause] [whispers] Kaya ngayon, pagbukas ng pinto sa lobby... tumatabi na lang ako. Para makalabas siya.

elevator-arrive.prompt: An old office building elevator arriving in an empty marble lobby at night: a soft mechanical slowdown, one single dull ding, then the steel doors sliding open with a heavy rumble, quiet echo, no voices.

shaft-loop.prompt: Inside an old elevator shaft at night: a low steady motor hum, steel cables creaking slowly, a faint hollow wind moving up the shaft, distant metallic ticks, dark and eerie, continuous ambience.

lobby-night-loop.prompt: An empty office building lobby at 3 a.m.: fluorescent tubes buzzing, an air conditioner droning, a security desk computer fan, very faint city traffic outside the glass doors, lonely and uneasy room tone.

glass-door.prompt: An automatic glass sliding door in a quiet lobby opening by itself at night: a motor whir, the glass panels sliding apart, a rush of outside air, then closing again with a soft thud.

note: Picks made by measurement (RMS, peak, onset), not by listening.
